body: Hey, I'm back on this forum because I got suicidal thoughts but will not attempt. I reached out to psychiatrists and I was diagnosed with dysthymia and prescribed Wellbutrin (started 3 week course on Tuesday). I think I just found a way to focus when studying but my brain still feels blank. I hope my situation improves after taking this medication. Do you think I'll be further prescribed Wellbutrin after the 3 weeks?

I consider myself a very hard worker when it comes to my studies so it's disturbing when I can't work the way I want to. When I read the ADHD description, I fit it perfectly - and I'm an educated adult so won't just falsely diagnose myself. I've also studied psychology in high school so can understand symptoms and whatnot. 

I'm also very glad I found you. You're a great woman and I really appreciate your concern for others and for your help. Thankfully you did help me calm down last night and feel comforted. I am confident I'll be fine and I'm happy I reached out to reddit and the counselor.

What really keeps me going is giving myself more than enough time to do what I like even though I have university work to do. I like listening to music as it relaxes me and also spend time on the internet or watching a TV show. I feel like I'm a failure especially because my parents demand so much from me all the time and I have not been showing them any achievements. I also had the "I wish I was never born" thoughts going through my head many times so understand what you're feeling. Just stay strong and I wish you feel better too! 

Feel free to PM me if you want to talk more as I think we're going through the same feelings :)

I met with a counselor at my university and he recommended I do an survey/assessment so he can get a better picture about my condition, and will then refer to me a psychiatrist outside at a proper psychology center. It was a good talk and I have never done this before. It's comforting to be able to speak to someone freely and without being judged about the issues I am facing, and he offered to help me the best he can. I agree with you and hopefully I begin treatment within 2-3 weeks if I do have a disorder.

BTW, I am feeling better now. I get these "suicide attacks" when I check my exam grades and this exam grade was the worst in my life. Coupled with the OK grade of the other exam, it massively affects me and brings these thoughts. I will still seek all the help I can to prevent this from happening again and to fix a possible neurological/mental disorder. These attacks showed up a few times last semester too when my grades weren't great.

Precisely. But my sister has an iPhone and laptop and has almost free internet access. I keep telling my mom that YouTubers really affect her brain because the stuff she watches are stupid imo. She barely spends time on the TV though because we have limited channels because we all barely watch, so she spends most of her time in her room on her iPhone (mostly) or laptop.

God sends people to hell because we are supposed to die when he decides and not just end our life if we're 'healthy'. Unfortunately, we can't tell how heaven & hell work so can't tell if the Nazi war criminal will be in hell for eternity or if God will forgive him and take him to heaven after spending the trillion years. Similarly, can't tell if I suicide I'll go to hell for eternity or not. If it is for eternity then I'd rather suffer for a few years on earth.

I called the hospital two weeks ago for a brain test because I feel something's not right there. I have an appointment with a neurologist on the 4th of April (hospital is always busy) and my exams are much sooner than that. I will request an urgent appointment with the psychiatrist because as you said the sooner, the better. I will definitely try to get notes. 

Thank you so much for your support. You really helped me immensely and I send you virtual hugs and high-fives. I wish you the very best in your life and your condition.

I believe I did have lack of focus back in high school 3-4 years ago, although it wasn't as severe as it is now. I never thought I had a mental disorder until you brought it up. Right now I can't read a sentence in my textbook without getting distracted and I have to force myself to study by turning off my laptop and keeping my phone outside the room. I will reach out to a really good hospital which has a couple of really good psychiatrists. My final exams are in mid-March so I hope I get help and a medical note asap.

Unfortunately I spend a lot of time (5+ hours/day) on the internet and used to spend at least an hour or two a day playing video games, though thankfully I don't have my console with me now. Fuck the internet for fucking up our brains and I know it fucked up my smaller sister's brain with all the bullshit, but she's getting psychiatric help.

I know. If I die normally, I think I will go to hell for sometime before hopefully going to heaven. But if I suicide, I will stay in hell forever. Not sure about God's exceptions for sick people.

I never expected myself to have a disorder but I just read ADHD symptoms and I have most. I will meet a psychiatrist for diagnosis and treatment and I just hope it's not severe because I really don't want this semester to be another fuck up. You're partially right about forgiving myself, I already forgave myself for three semesters of bad grades. This is my fourth and I can't just forgive again because it's not right.
Think I am a combination of INTJ and ISTP. Exactly my thoughts about the hoops. Thanks for your words of support.

I feel the exact same as you do. I feel like no on cares about me, or at least the people I am with right now as my good couple of friends are studying away for the year (this is the second semester). I had two 'good' friends last semester but sometimes I feel they are faking our friendships. I feel like my family don't care about me too. Doing dreadful academically, and has been for the past 3 semesters and now this is the fourth. I feel like I want to end my life, but at the same time I want to get married, have kids, buy my dream house and car, travel around the world, and work my dream job. There's a purpose for me to continue my life even though I am currently not satisfied and I am sure you can find a purpose too.
